draft.subject: Getting Harbor Dynamics started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks again for the dark mode question — as I mentioned, it isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and your ticket is closed on our side.

In the meantime, I'd like to help you get set up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is the natural starting point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Want me to walk you through that first project on a short call this week? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Chidi
